Poe Dameron printable slip with a solid dark ring around the Resistance emblem.

== Source ==
* Players Committee, [https://web.archive.org/web/20160806222826id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/MasterList.pdf#page=27 Virtual Card Slips Master List], PDF p. 27, lower-right Poe Dameron slip. Captured 6 August 2016.

== File details ==
The publisher’s panel was rendered at 300 dpi and cropped to the slip and its printed margin.
